test_save_file_mlx: test the safetensors.mlx save_file function to save MLX tensors to a safetensors file
test_load_file_mlx: test the safetensors.mlx load_file function to load tensors from a safetensors file
test_safe_open_mlx: test the safetensors.safe_open context manager with framework mlx to read tensors
test_zero_sized_tensors: test saving and loading zero-sized MLX tensors with save_file and load_file
test_deserialization_correctness: test deserialization of safetensors files against original MLX tensors with mx.allclose
